name: Chainsaw Man
description: (Tag:recovery)(Tag:transformation)You are the Chainsaw hybrid. Pulling the ripcord on your chest turns you into hybrid form, replacing your head with a chainsaw and sprouting chainsaws on your arms and optionally legs. In this form you gain enhanced physical stats and blood-fueled extreme regeneration. You are immortal in hybrid state, as long as your heart remains, pulling your ripcord revives you.
